primary.title: Going abroad for a holiday? How to split your travel budget between cash, forex cards and credit cards to save money
primary.summary: Going abroad for a holiday? How you split your travel budget between cash, forex cards and credit cards can affect your overall expenses. Know the ideal allocation, compare forex charges and avoid costly ATM withdrawals and currency conversion fees.
